title: Citizenship
quote: India has shifted from jus soli to jus sanguinis; NRI = citizen abroad, PIO and OCI = foreign citizens

boxes.title: Articles 5-11 (Part II)
head: Art.
Deals with
rows: At **commencement** (**26 Jan 1950**): domicile + birth / parent born / **5 years** residence

boxes.title: Acquisition: 5 modes (B-D-R-N-I)
head: Mode
Sec.
Condition
rows: To **30 Jun 1987**: any; from **1 July 1987**: one parent Indian; from **3 Dec 2004**: both, or one + other not illegal migrant
Born abroad; either parent Indian (**jus sanguinis**)
PIO resident ==**7 years**==; spouses of citizens

cards.title: Renunciation (Sec. 8)
lines: Minor may resume within **1** year of majority

cards.title: Deprivation (Sec. 10)
lines: By the **Centre**: fraud, disloyalty, enemy trade
Jail **2 years** within **5 years** of naturalisation

items.what: **CAA**: assent **12 Dec 2019**; **6** non-Muslim communities from **Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Pakistan**; entry by ==**31 December 2014**==; residence → **5 years**
New Rules: passport surrender within **15 days**; **District Collectors** in **8** States/UTs; **250+** petitions (Art. **14**)

boxes.title: Single citizenship & OCI
items: President: by birth or naturalised (USA: natural-born only)
**OCI** (Sec. **7A**): ==lifelong visa==; no vote, no public posts; Pakistan/Bangladesh links barred

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: Marrying a foreigner / buying property: no effect on citizenship
CAA exempts **Sixth Schedule** areas + **Inner Line Permit** areas
⚠ other notes: naturalisation normally **11 years**; registration **6 months** (old)
